newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia and Germany sign an investment protection agreement.
- Prince Al-Waleed buys 50 percent stake in Landmark Entertainment Group.
- Kuwait oil company to construct two projects worth $400 million.
- Saudi British Bank share jumps to 500 riyals in Saudi stock market on Tuesday.
- A new utility company to be set up in the kingdom in 1997 with a capital of $500 million.
